subject: test: add end-to-end harness for embedded SFTP browser and xterm.js terminal
body:
test: add end-to-end harness for embedded SFTP browser and xterm.js terminal

Resurrects the orphaned mRemoteNGSpecs project (broken since the .NET 10
migration) and turns it into a full E2E suite for PR #3258.

- Migrate from the discontinued TechTalk.SpecFlow to Reqnroll, retarget
  net9.0 -> net10.0, and re-add the project to mRemoteNG.sln.
- SFTP Cucumber feature: 8 scenarios driving SftpFileService (connect,
  list, upload, download, create/rename/delete) against a disposable
  atmoz/sftp Docker container, managed by Reqnroll BeforeFeature/
  AfterFeature hooks. Without Docker the scenarios are ignored, not failed.
- Playwright for .NET: loads the real xterm.js terminal page in Chromium
  with a stubbed chrome.webview bridge and verifies rendering, the host
  message protocol, ANSI colour, and keyboard input.
- Verify: deterministic text snapshot of the rendered terminal plus a
  PNG screenshot baseline (Playwright captures, Verify compares).

All 22 tests pass locally (9 xterm.js, 8 SFTP, 5 credential repository).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
